description: This file defines a GradientRenderer class responsible for rendering a gradient using OpenGL ES, including shader setup, drawing routines, and color generation. It also includes a static function to create a renderer instance that manages rendering lifecycle.

classes.name: GradientRenderer
classes.description: Handles OpenGL shader program setup, rendering a gradient with color interpolation, and managing associated OpenGL state.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes shader program and textures for gradient rendering.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by GradientRenderer.

methods.name: drawGradient
methods.description: Executes OpenGL commands to draw a gradient rectangle with interpolated colors.
